label: On RECEIVES_ESSE_AT_3 present-tense reception is accompaniment, checked (inference)
rule: Unfold relationalReceipt: its first two conjuncts are the hypotheses of the present-tense reading, its third is accompaniment's consequent
meaning: Closed result with no premises, quantified over every history, origin relation and reception predicate. On the relational sense the present-tense reading of reception says that a received-esse thing present at t bears the origin relation at t to something, which is accompaniment, in both directions. It establishes nothing about reality.
